title: A body with an older in-file stamp neither revises stored records nor replaces last-known-good
notes: Step 2's ALTTP4 719 is the real record with its Comment line altered, modelling an older text served by a stale cache. No such text was observed in the capture.
ALTTP2 1531 has already ended when first seen at 16:47, but its latest version was issued at 16:46, inside the new-notice grace window, so it alerts.
